meta.title: Bhoomisetu — land and homes with clear checks and clear prices
meta.description: Compare every agent's price for the same land, see what was checked, and read area in gajams, guntas and acres. In Telugu, Hindi and English.

home.heroTitle: Find land you can trust, compare every price, in your language.
home.heroSubtitle: Farm land and house plots to buy and sell. Every agent's price for the same land side by side, with what was checked.
home.verifiedBody: Every badge names the check that was done: phone code, identity, owner confirmation. Nothing more is claimed.
home.compareBody: All agents' prices, brokerage and authority for the same land, side by side, ranked by a rule you can read.
home.unitsBody: Every area in acres, guntas, cents, gajams (square yards), square feet and square metres.
home.languageBody: Search and read in the language you are most comfortable with.
home.safety: Never pay a token advance before visiting the site and checking the documents.
home.examples: Try a village, mandal or district in any language: Mokila · మోకిల · मोकिला

agricultural.title: Farm land
agricultural.body: Acres and guntas, survey number, road access

home.checksTitle: A badge says exactly what was checked

home.checksNote: A badge never means the land title is clear. Ask a lawyer before paying.
home.contactBody: Buyers sign in before they can message an owner or agent on WhatsApp, and each person can contact a limited number of listers a day.
home.sellBody: List it once. Every agent's price for it appears on one page, so buyers compare fairly.

compare.title: Compare offers for this land
compare.howTitle: How best value is worked out
compare.howBody: Price to you (asking price plus brokerage) counts {price}%, owner authority {authority}%, checks passed {checks}%, reply time {response}% and how recently availability was confirmed {freshness}%. A price below {outlier}% of the other offers' median is flagged, because very low prices are a common bait. Paid promotion never changes this order.

footer.disclaimer: Bhoomisetu shows what was checked and when. A check is not a legal title opinion; consult a lawyer before paying.
footer.tagline: One land, every price, in your language.

signin.title: Sign in with your mobile number

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Public papers shared by the owner or agent: brochure, site plan, maps, HMDA or DTCP approval, RERA certificate, building permission and photos.
documents.safetyTitle: Before you pay any token amount
documents.safety: Bhoomisetu never shows the sale deed, EC, pattadar passbook or ROR-1B. Ask the seller to show the originals, check them at the sub-registrar office or Dharani/Meebhoomi, and pay any token amount only after that, against a written receipt.
